title: Anadiplosis — Beginning as You Finished
skills: define anadiplosis as a rhetorical and literary device
identify repetition in which the end of one clause begins the next
analyze how anadiplosis creates emphasis, rhythm, and cohesion
apply anadiplosis intentionally in persuasive and creative writing
alignment_note: Explains anadiplosis as a repetition technique in which the final word or phrase of one clause or sentence is repeated at the beginning of the next. Supports rhetorical analysis, close reading, sentence style, emphasis, rhythm, and author's craft across high school English courses.
